subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Understands and uses the future tense ('I will go to town tomorrow')

show.line: Tomorrow I will go to town! I will take the bus.

rounds.prompt: Tomorrow I ... go to town. Which word?

rounds.text: I will go to town tomorrow.
accept: i will go to town tomorrow

rounds.prompt: What will you do tomorrow? Start with, I will.
Yesterday I ... the train. Will take or took?
rounds.praise: Yes! Yesterday I took the train.

hints: Yesterday is the past. Tomorrow is the future.

beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Tomorrow I went to the shop!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Tomorrow I will go to the shop.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Tomorrow I will go!

parent_line: Can talk about the future: tomorrow I will go.
